metadata.description: Brendan Kowitz's marketplace of agents and skills for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code.

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Six specialized PR review agents (code quality, test coverage, silent failures, comment accuracy, type design, simplification) plus a /pr-review-toolkit command that orchestrates them all. Ported from Anthropic's Claude Code pr-review-toolkit (Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: discover
plugins.description: Start a feature right: create feature areas and run structured investigations with explicit accept/reject outcomes before committing to an approach.

plugins.name: decide
plugins.description: Architecture Decision Records: analyze, draft, and accept ADRs. Includes the adr-analyzer agent plus create-adr and accept-adr skills.

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: Levelled coding agents (fast-coding-agent, coding-agent, complex-coding-agent) plus coding-philosophy, implement-task, and engineer-mode skills.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Well-Architected reviews (full, security, reliability, performance) and technical PR review, backed by the well-architected-agent.

plugins.name: document
plugins.description: Keep documentation and session knowledge current: documentation-agent, persona-agent (models your style from agent-journal sessions), update-documentation and agent-journal skills.

plugins.name: experimental
plugins.description: Staging area for in-development agents and skills. Contents are unstable and change without notice; skills carry a -next suffix so they can run alongside their stable counterparts.
